title: EPFO to Celebrate 74th Foundation Day in New Delhi Tomorrow
subtitle: Union Minister Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya to inaugurate proceedings, launch key EPFO initiatives
body_text: The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) will celebrate its 74th Foundation Day in New Delhi tomorrow. Union Minister for Labour & Employment and Youth Affairs & Sports, Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya , will inaugurate the event. The celebration will be attended by senior officials of the Ministry of Labour & Employment, Members of the Central Board of Trustees, officers and employees of EPFO, employers, workers and other stakeholders. On the occasion, Dr. Mandaviya will launch key EPFO initiatives, including the Automatic Settlement of Eligible Inoperative EPF Accounts with balances up to ₹1,000 and EPFO Services through WhatsApp, among others. The Union Minister will also review exhibition stalls at the venue, and release a series of publications reflecting EPFO's commitment to knowledge creation, institutional learning, legal awareness and compassionate governance. The proceedings will also see Dr. Mandaviya presenting Bhavishya Nidhi Awards 2026 to recognise outstanding contributions by Regional Offices, Zonal Offices, individual officers and employees. The 74th Foundation Day celebration seeks to reaffirm that the journey of EPFO is not merely a story of institutional growth; it is a continuing commitment to ensure that the fruits of a worker's years of labour translate into security, dignity and peace of mind for the worker and the family. ****** Rini Choudhury / Aishwarya Asthana
